test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following ministries released the draft National Air Sports Policy, 2022, in the January 2022?

options.text: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Civil Aviation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Minister of Civil Aviation **Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia** launched** National Air Sport Policy 2022 (NASP 2022).**
 
• **NASP **2022 lays out the vision of making India one of the **top sports nations by 2030**, by providing a **safe, affordable, accessible, enjoyable and sustainable air sports ecosystem in India.**
 
• ** The NASP 2022, **is a** step toward providing safe and affordable sustainable air sports.**
 
• It has been drafted based on the inputs received from policymakers, air sports practitioners and the public at large and will ensure the establishment of good quality infrastructure, equipment, instructors and services.
